title: Light Retractor Control Relay and Motor Testing

content.description: Continuity test diagram showing relay terminals 1-6 with two meters connected. Left meter shows terminals 3, 5 and 6; right meter shows terminals 1 and 2. Battery connections to terminals 3 and 4.

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 3. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminals 1 and 2.
(b) Check the continuity between terminals 3 and 5 and terminals 3 and 6.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the relay.
INSPECTION OF LIGHT RETRACTOR CONTROL RELAY

content.description: Light retractor control relay diagram showing relay with terminals 1-6, battery connection, and meter. Terminals 5 and 1 are shown at top of relay.

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 5. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 1.
(b) Connect the negative (−) lead from the battery to terminal 3. After disconnecting the connection between terminal 3 and battery, check the continuity for 6 − 14 seconds between terminals 1 and 2.

(c) Check the continuity between terminals 1 and 4 after connecting the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 6. After disconnecting the connection between terminal 6 and the battery, check that there is continuity for 2 − 4 seconds between terminals 1 and 4, and continuity immediately for 6 − 14 seconds between terminals 1 and 2.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the relay.

content.description: Alternative continuity test diagram for light retractor control relay showing different test configuration with two meters. Left meter connected to terminals 6 and 4; right meter on other terminals.

content.text: Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 2 and connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 5. Check that the motor runs.
If there is no motor operation, replace the motor.

content.description: Circular motor connector terminal diagram showing 5 terminals numbered 1-5 arranged in a circle, viewed from terminal side

items: (a) Move the headlights to any position except the uppermost or lowermost position.
(b) Connect the ohmmeter positive (+) lead to terminal 4 and the negative (−) lead to terminal 5.
(c) Connect the ohmmeter positive (+) lead to terminal 4 and the negative (−) lead to terminal 3.

content.text: If there is no continuity, replace the motor assembly.

content.description: Two side-by-side diagrams showing continuity testing of motor with headlights in different positions. Each shows a motor housing with internal components and meter connections.
